name: Proposal Follow-Up Sequence
goal: Automatically remind prospects and reps when proposals are open but not signed.

trigger.event: Proposal status changes to sent or remains open for the configured wait period
setup_notes: Connect the proposal or CRM system.
Confirm the signed, declined, and expired status values.
Create wait periods that match the sales team's follow-up policy.

workflow_steps.name: Find open proposals
workflow_steps.instructions: Search for proposals where status is sent, viewed, or open and the close date has not passed.

workflow_steps.name: Exclude closed records
workflow_steps.instructions: Stop the workflow when the proposal is signed, declined, expired, or manually paused.

workflow_steps.name: Send timed follow-up
workflow_steps.instructions: Send the approved template for the current follow-up day and include the proposal link, owner signature, and next-step call to action.

workflow_steps.name: Create rep task
workflow_steps.instructions: Create a task for the owner when the proposal remains open after the configured wait period.

workflow_steps.name: Update CRM activity
workflow_steps.instructions: Log the follow-up email or task in the CRM so the opportunity timeline stays complete.

manual_tests.name: Open proposal follow-up
manual_tests.input: A proposal that has been open longer than the first wait period.
manual_tests.expected_result: Follow-up message is sent and CRM activity is logged.

manual_tests.name: Signed proposal exclusion
manual_tests.expected_result: Workflow stops without sending any follow-up.

manual_tests.name: Missing owner
manual_tests.input: An open proposal without an assigned owner.
manual_tests.expected_result: Workflow assigns fallback owner or sends an error alert.

handoff_instructions: Review all follow-up templates with sales leadership before launch.
Make sure the unsubscribe or opt-out process is respected for external messages.
Monitor reply and close rates after each follow-up interval.
